when: After frozen dataset and before any heldout model requests or responses
purpose: Secondary sensitivity analysis; no changes to original heldout labels, prompt selection, or thresholds. Recompute heldout statistics with these three cases treated as eligible photographs.

cases.R0226: A very blurred page photographed at an angle with a visible wooden edge and orange surface; degree of meaningful surrounding context is debatable.
cases.R0317: Worn and folded printed cardboard with physical edges and surface detail; context is mostly the object itself.
cases.R0356: A printed illustrated card with an identifiable edge, adjacent tabletop and other surrounding surface. Its original excluded label may be inconsistent with preserving photos of physical objects with context.
